title: Effective Phantom Dark Energy: What Cosmological Reconstruction Does and Does Not Imply (S. S. Mishra)
efc_relevance: Demonstrates that the effective phantom behaviour seen in DESI+CMB+SNe reconstructions does NOT imply a fundamental phantom field or NEC violation — the apparent w(z) < −1 can arise from an effective-fluid description of a non-phantom underlying theory. Critically important for EFC's positioning: EFC's L2→L3 effective phantom-crossing is an emergent statement about the entropic source term, not evidence for a fundamental phantom scalar, and this paper provides the theoretical cover for that distinction.
